example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামে সবাই তাকে উটকপালী বলে এড়িয়ে চলে।
তার উটকপালীর লক্ষণ দেখে বিয়ের প্রস্তাব বাতিল হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone in the village avoids her, calling her an ill-omened woman.
The marriage proposal was canceled after noticing her unlucky forehead signs.
history: Originates from Bengali physiognomy (lakshana shastra), where physical features like a broad forehead resembling a camel's hump are deemed inauspicious for women, indicating misfortune.
note: This idiom reflects outdated gender-based superstitions prevalent in traditional Bengali society.
